This application coming on for admission this day, the co  following:
 ORDER Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the applicant/accused,
relating to FIR/Crime No.46/2024 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station - City Biaora,
District Rajgarh (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376 and 376(2)(n) of IPC alongwith Sections 3/4 and 5(L)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Prosecution story, in brief is that at the time of incident, prosecutrix was aged about 16 years and 07 months.
Prior to the incident, the prosecutrix and the applicant were known to each other and both of them also wanted to marry.
On 27.01.2024, the prosecutrix left her home and went to Ajmer alongwith the applicant, where the applicant committed rape upon the prosecutrix.

On 06.02.2024,
the Police had recovered the prosecutrix from possession of the present applicant.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant/accused submits that the applicant has not committed the offence and he has falsely been implicated in the case.
It is submitted that the prosecutrix herself left her home and went to the applicant.
She was consenting party for sexual intercourse.
It is also submitted that at the time of the incident, the prosecutrix was more than 18 years of age.

Therefore,
no offence is made out against the applicant.
4. It is submitted that applicant is in custody since 06.02.2024.
Trial will take considerable long time for its disposal, therefore, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the non-applicant/State as well as learned counsel for the objector have opposed the prayer and prayed for its rejection.

6. Having considered the rival submissions and after perusal of the case diary so also considering the facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail hence, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant - Arjun Singh shall be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Trial Court during pendency of the trial.
It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of trial but in case of bail jump, it shall become ineffective.
9. With the aforesaid, this application is allowed and stands disposed of.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
